$Comment: The Christmas Wand: point it at another player and dress them up. Primary turns them into one of Santa's elves (Christmas_Wand_Cast_Elf), Secondary into a reindeer (Christmas_Wand_Cast_Reindeer); both share the one five-second cooldown Christmas_Wand. It dresses only another player, who can take the costume off with /zigcostume off, and a costume that lands counts as USE_ITEM with the Qualifier Costume for the player who cast it. It wears the game's own wooden wand (Weapon_Wand_Wood's model, texture, icon and sparkle).
